_schema: ccteam qa-autoloop config v1 — fill in every TODO before launching the workflow
name: TODO-project-slug
description: TODO short one-liner about what this project is
_local_path_note: absolute path to the project's git working tree on this machine; agents cd here on every step
_fix_disabled_note: set to true to pause the fixer (e.g. during a release freeze); tester + releaser still run
_deploy_note: deploy provider. Set kind=none for projects without a staging deploy (releaser will skip the deploy + acceptance steps).

test._note: tester + releaser only ever hit staging_url (RED LINE: never automate against production)

_frontend_test_note: framework + entry point for UI tests. Set kind=none for backend-only projects.
_backend_test_note: optional. If your project ships a CLI/SDK used as the test harness, declare it here. Tester will probe it; otherwise skip.
_review_note: review surface for fixer's PRs. Copilot = GitHub Copilot code review, codereview-bot = generic auto-reviewer, human = wait for manual approval (releaser will park PRs until human acks).

issue_tracker._note: Issues live as per-file JSON under .ccteam/issues/<id>.json. GitHub Issues NOT used as the tracker — only PRs hit GitHub.
